payload.reason: The evidence describes the types of repetitive and time-consuming activities that Intelligent Process Automation (IPA) systems and Robotic Process Automation (RPA) systems handle, specifically mentioning tasks like data entry and executing routine workflows.

claims.text: IPA systems handle repetitive, routine, and low-cognitive tasks, allowing workers to focus on more intelligent processes.
RPA systems simulate hand-operated human activities like entering data into a system and accomplishing straightforward but repetitive workflows.
IPA-bots can perform time-consuming and routine tasks, enabling smart workflows and freeing up skilled workers for higher-value activities.
